summary: HUTCHMED filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing initiation of the Phase Ia portion of a global first-in-human trial of HMPL-A830, a first-in-class KRAS-EGFR antibody-targeted therapy conjugate, in unresectable advanced or metastatic solid tumors; the first patient was dosed in China on September 24, 2026. The filing also notes a September 3, 2026 exclusive development and license agreement with a GSK subsidiary covering worldwide rights excluding Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, subject to customary closing conditions including antitrust review. This is an ordinary pipeline/clinical update, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply. Watch future trial data and GSK milestone economics.
